name: Runecarver

passives.name: Energized
passives.effects: Moving and basic attacking generates Energize stacks, up to 100.

passives.name: Helix
passives.effects: Dealing damage with an ability generates 30 Energize stacks and triggers the effects of Energized attacks if they are ready (2.5-second cooldown per cast instance).

passives.name: Spiral Out
passives.effects: When fully Energized, your next basic attack generates a Rune stack and fires a missile at the target for each Rune stack you have, dealing 20 – 45 (based on level) magic damage (+11% bonus AD) (+8% AP) (+0.3 per 100 bonus health) magic damage with each missile. Stacks are reset every round and between each phase in a round.

description:
80 Ability Power
20 Ability Haste
4% Move Speed

Helix
Moving, attacking, and dealing damage with an ability grants 30 Energized stacks and triggers Energized Actions if it is ready.

Spiral Out
On Energized Action, gain a Rune stack for the rest of the round. Then fire a missile at the target for each Rune stack, dealing  magic damage.
